slides.0.title: Labels and international protection
slides.0.subtitle: How a name may be used is also law
slides.1.title: The 2001 rule on regional names
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Article 1: what may appear
slides.1.highlights.0.content: AOC wines may carry the name of a zone viticole from the 1975 order, or a region named in the AOC orders, provided the wine really comes from there
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Article 2: not a brand
slides.1.highlights.1.content: These zone and region names may not be used as a commercial name (dénomination commerciale)
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Article 3: repeal
slides.1.highlights.2.content: It repeals the order of 20 August 1982. It is signed by the Minister of Agriculture, Sadok Rabeh
slides.1.content: A label may name a smaller place, but that name may not become a brand.
slides.2.title: Protection under Law 99-57
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Not on products from outside
slides.2.highlights.0.content: Article 16: once an AOC is accepted, its name may not be used on similar products from outside the area
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Not even imitation
slides.2.highlights.1.content: Imitating or referring to the name is banned even when the label says the product is not from the area. The same goes for packaging, documents and advertising
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Use comes with fees
slides.2.highlights.2.content: Article 36: using an AOC involves a contribution, plus a fee to the control and certification body
slides.2.content: Protection goes beyond the label to packaging, documents and advertising.
slides.3.title: The Lisbon Agreement
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Joining
slides.3.highlights.0.content: Tunisia deposited its instrument of accession on 31 July 1973, joining the text as revised at Stockholm in 1967
slides.3.highlights.1.title: Seven wine registrations
slides.3.highlights.1.content: Nos. 589–595 were registered on 9 July 1974: Kélibia, Muscat de Kélibia, Vin Muscat de Kélibia, Muscat de Thibar, Coteaux de Tébourba, Sidi Salem and Mornag VDQS
slides.3.highlights.2.title: The Geneva Act
slides.3.highlights.2.content: Tunisia joined the Geneva Act of the Lisbon Agreement on 6 April 2023, in force from 6 July. Iran refused protection for all seven registrations in 2007
slides.3.content: The international entries stop in 1974, so the later Grand Cru Mornag, Coteaux d'Utique and AOC Mornag are not on the list.
slides.4.componentProps.slide.title: 🧠 Knowledge check
Under the 2001 order, zone and region names may not be used as what?
A. A commercial name
B. The origin on a label
C. Export documents
D. The name of a cooperative
Article 2. The origin may be stated but not turned into a brand.
What does article 16 of Law 99-57 ban?
A. Stating the vintage
B. Imitating the name, even when the product is said not to come from the area
C. Using the name inside the area
D. Exporting AOC wine
References on packaging, documents and advertising are banned too.
Which of these is NOT among the 1974 Lisbon registrations?
A. Muscat de Thibar
B. Coteaux de Tébourba
C. Coteaux d'Utique
D. Sidi Salem
Coteaux d'Utique was created only in 1980.
When did the Geneva Act take effect for Tunisia?
6 July 2023. The original Lisbon Agreement dates from 1973.
